title: AAP Action Descriptor v0.1
description: JSON Schema for an AAP Action Descriptor — describes a callable action that can cross AI vendor boundaries.

aap_version.description: AAP spec version. Must be '0.1' for this spec version.

id.description: Stable identifier for this action. UUID v4 recommended.

name.description: Machine-readable snake_case name. Namespaced vendor actions use double-underscore: vendor__action.

version.description: Semver version of this action descriptor.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the action does.

side_effects.description: Side-effect classification. Empty = none. 'none' must not appear with other values.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) describing the input parameters.

descriptor_signature.description: SHA-256 hash of this descriptor's canonical JSON (signature field removed). Format: sha256:<hex>.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) describing the output. Optional.

required.description: If true, invocation requires explicit user authorization. Default: false.

principal_kind.description: Who must authorize: user (default), operator, or system.

idempotent.description: Whether repeated calls with the same input produce the same result.

cancellable.description: Whether in-flight invocations can be cancelled.

vendor.description: Vendor slug that exposes this action (e.g., cursor, anthropic).

execution_plane.description: Where the action executes: local device, cloud runtime, remote PAL/3 UDP peer, or hybrid.

egress_class.description: Data egress classification aligned with pal3-ai/1 gateway enforcement.

catalog_tier.description: Unified PAL Realm catalog tier: primitive (atomic tool), blueprint (composite ADK workflow), or mesh_service (live PAL/3 UDP 52474 peer worker).

adk.description: Google ADK-aligned agent composition metadata (BaseAgent -> LlmAgent, SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, LoopAgent, session.state output_key, and sub_agents delegation).

workflow_type.description: Orchestration pattern inspired by Google ADK.

output_key.description: Shared session.state key where this agent/tool stores its structured output.

sub_agents.description: Ordered or parallel child primitive/blueprint IDs composed by this agent.

transfer_allowed.description: Whether dynamic LLM-driven sub-agent transfer (AgentTool / transfer_to_agent) is permitted.

economy.description: Agent micro-economy pricing, FinOps budget ceiling, creator royalty, compute host share, and SLA metadata.

billing_model.description: How invocations of this action are metered in the Agent Economy.

price_per_call_usd.description: Fixed price per invocation in USD (0 for free/local).

creator_royalty_bps.description: Marketplace creator royalty in basis points (100 bps = 1%).

compute_host_share_bps.description: PAL/3 peer compute host settlement share in basis points (100 bps = 1%).

max_cost_usd.description: Hard FinOps circuit-breaker ceiling for a single invocation in USD.

sla_latency_ms.description: Target p95 execution SLA in milliseconds.
